notes: Streaming, experimental. The Library opens with a Streaming block: search a song, add it, and it plays from the source without being downloaded or saved to your device. It is marked experimental because the source is not ours and its links expire.
Your downloaded songs are a section of their own, under a “Downloaded songs” heading right beneath the streaming block, so the two never look like one list.

Streaming playlists. A streaming song has its own ＋ button: type a playlist name (a new one is created if it does not exist) and the playlist appears as a chip that plays through it. Streaming playlists are stored separately from your downloaded ones and can never be confused with them.

An expired link fixes itself. A stream is re-resolved after thirty minutes, and again the moment the source refuses it — the same song, resumed at the position it was on. A song that cannot be re-resolved says so instead of sitting there silently.
It uses its own player, so a stream that dies cannot touch your queue, widget or downloaded playback.
